title: Instructors can preview, select and add single tracks from Music playlists and Songs
acceptance: Playlist detail and Songs rows offer preview and select, reusing the builder's TrackPreview path, and an "Add selected" or "Start class from selected" action (D21).
The playlist header shows a track count when the provider reports one, and the 15-song import limit is stated before Start class.
Preview plays only through the official provider SDK or widget; nothing is cached.
Keyboard and screen-reader access match the existing builder preview.
nextAction: Design pass first: where selection lives and what it adds to (new class or an open class). Files: apps/web/src/components/Dashboard.tsx (Music song rows and playlist dialog), TrackPreview.tsx, PlaylistSongPicker.tsx. Owner-gated (playback): the PR needs owner-approved and a real-browser preview check. Surface: web.
